source: skills/ui-evaluator/references/knowledge/accessibility.md §6 (W3C WCAG 2.2, Recommendation 2024-12-12; ISO/IEC 40500:2025). Criterion names are paraphrased as in that file; SC 4.1.1 is obsolete and omitted.
note: `coverage` is the last verification method in the row (auto, scripted, judged, human), which the A11Y-20 coverage matrix records; `methods` lists every step. A fail at any step makes the criterion fail.

criteria.name: Non-text content
criteria.verification: auto (image-alt, svg-img-alt, role-img-alt, input-image-alt) + judged (alt is equivalent, or the image is correctly decorative)

criteria.name: Audio-only and video-only, prerecorded
criteria.verification: human (transcript or alternative present and accurate)

criteria.name: Captions, prerecorded
criteria.verification: auto (video-caption: a captions track exists) + human (accurate and in sync)

criteria.name: Audio description or media alternative
criteria.verification: human

criteria.name: Captions, live
criteria.verification: human

criteria.name: Audio description, prerecorded
criteria.verification: human

criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.verification: auto (list, listitem, th-has-data-cells, aria-required-children) + scripted (forms; ARIA snapshot outline) + judged (visual structure vs ARIA outline)

criteria.name: Meaningful sequence
criteria.verification: scripted signal (ARIA snapshot order vs visual boxes; CSS order, grid placement) + human

criteria.name: Sensory characteristics
criteria.verification: judged (copy scanned for shape, position, colour or sound-only instructions) + human

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.verification: judged (uie probe at portrait and landscape viewports; no orientation lock)

criteria.name: Identify input purpose
criteria.verification: auto (autocomplete-valid, for tokens present) + scripted (forms: personal-data fields missing tokens)

criteria.name: Use of colour
criteria.verification: auto (link-in-text-block) + scripted (cvd captures) + judged

criteria.name: Audio control
criteria.verification: auto (no-autoplay-audio)

criteria.name: Contrast, minimum
criteria.verification: auto (color-contrast) + scripted (contrast: composited, pixel-sampled, all states and themes)

criteria.name: Resize text
criteria.verification: auto (meta-viewport) + scripted (layout: text at 200%)

criteria.name: Images of text
criteria.verification: judged (raster or canvas text in captures)

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.verification: scripted (layout at 320 px)

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.verification: scripted (contrast: boundaries, icons, chart marks, focus and state indicators)

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.verification: scripted (layout: spacing overrides injected)

criteria.name: Content on hover or focus
criteria.verification: scripted (uie probe: Esc dismisses without moving the pointer, the pointer can move onto it, it persists) + judged; see CMP-21

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.verification: auto (scrollable-region-focusable, frame-focusable-content) + scripted (keyboard)

criteria.name: No keyboard trap
criteria.verification: scripted (keyboard: the walk wraps; Esc leaves modal widgets)

criteria.name: Character key shortcuts
criteria.verification: scripted (uie lint) + judged (remap, off switch or focus-only)

criteria.name: Timing adjustable
criteria.verification: auto (meta-refresh) + judged (session timeouts, auto-advancing steps)

criteria.name: Pause, stop, hide
criteria.verification: auto (blink, marquee) + scripted (motion: infinite animations) + judged (auto-advance over 5 s without a pause control)

criteria.name: Three flashes or below threshold
criteria.verification: scripted signal (motion: short-period infinite animations) + human (flashes faster than 3 per second, video)

criteria.name: Bypass blocks
criteria.verification: auto (bypass) + scripted (keyboard: the first stop is a working skip link)

criteria.name: Page titled
criteria.verification: auto (document-title) + judged (descriptive and unique per route)

criteria.name: Focus order
criteria.verification: scripted (keyboard: order vs visual order; dialogs: focus in and back)

criteria.name: Link purpose in context
criteria.verification: auto (link-name) + scripted (copy: generic link text) + judged

criteria.name: Multiple ways
criteria.verification: judged (navigation plus search or a sitemap, site-wide)

criteria.name: Headings and labels
criteria.verification: judged (they describe topic or purpose)

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.verification: scripted (keyboard: focused vs blurred crop diff)

criteria.name: Focus not obscured, minimum
criteria.verification: scripted (keyboard: point sampling in both directions)

criteria.name: Pointer gestures
criteria.verification: judged (multipoint and path gestures have single-pointer controls)

criteria.name: Pointer cancellation
criteria.verification: scripted (uie lint: down-event actions)

criteria.name: Label in name
criteria.verification: scripted signal (ARIA snapshot: visible label text inside the accessible name) + judged

criteria.name: Motion actuation
criteria.verification: scripted (uie lint: device-motion handlers) + judged

criteria.name: Dragging movements
criteria.verification: scripted (uie lint: drag-only handlers) + judged (uie probe alternative)

criteria.name: Target size, minimum
criteria.verification: auto (target-size, enabled by wcag22aa) + scripted (targets: circle test)

criteria.name: Language of page
criteria.verification: auto (html-has-lang, html-lang-valid) + scripted (lang: script vs tag)

criteria.name: Language of parts
criteria.verification: auto (valid-lang) + scripted (lang: untagged runs in another script)

criteria.name: On focus
criteria.verification: scripted (keyboard: no navigation, window or modal on focus alone)

criteria.name: On input
criteria.verification: scripted signal (uie probe: change selects and radios, watch for unannounced context changes) + judged

criteria.name: Consistent navigation
criteria.verification: scripted (cross-page: navigation order)

criteria.name: Consistent identification
criteria.verification: scripted (cross-page: same function, same name)

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.verification: scripted (cross-page: help mechanisms in the same relative order)

criteria.name: Error identification
criteria.verification: scripted (forms: text error, aria-invalid, association)

criteria.name: Labels or instructions
criteria.verification: auto (label, form-field-multiple-labels) + scripted (forms: no placeholder-only label) + judged (format hints)

criteria.name: Error suggestion
criteria.verification: judged (the message says how to fix it; CPY-04)

criteria.name: Error prevention for legal, financial and data submissions
criteria.verification: judged (review, confirm or undo; CMP-15) + human

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.verification: judged (journey replay: earlier answers offered again within the process)

criteria.name: Accessible authentication, minimum
criteria.verification: scripted (forms: paste, tokens) + judged (puzzles and alternatives)

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.verification: auto (about 29 rules: button-name, label, select-name, nested-interactive, aria-*) + scripted (uie probe toggles with an ARIA snapshot diff) + judged

criteria.name: Status messages
criteria.verification: scripted (live-regions: outcome lands in a live region after async actions)
